meta.title: Tamil Songs
meta.description: Fieldwork photographs and video of Tamil singers, drummers and lament performers recorded in Tamilnadu between 1982 and 2000.

attrs.alt: Tamil singers in headcloths performing outdoors with frame drums, villagers and children seated on the slope behind them.
attrs.headline: Tamil Songs

items.title: Singing for the goddess
items.caption: Two Tamil musician sing songs in honor of the goddess Mariamman at a festival near Ootacamund, Tamil Nadu, 1991. They accompany themselves on uṭukkai (hourglass shaped drum) and tappaṭṭai (frame drum)

items.title: Tamil Folk Singers
items.caption: Kanniyappan and M Rasu (maybe), Madurai, Tamilnadu, 1982-83

items.title: Children of Parali village
items.caption: Listening to the adults singing, Parali village, Tamilnadu, India, 1983

items.title: Parali village 1983
items.caption: Women singing lullabies and laments, surrounded by fellow villagers, Parali (near Madurai), Tamilnadu, India

items.title: Candira's lament
items.caption: Candira, age 42 in 1999, sings a Tamil lament (oppari) for her daughter, who is still alive. Menaci village, Dharmapuri district, Tamilnadu, Jan 1, 2000

items.title: Kolāṭṭam in Menasi village
items.caption: A form of Tamil stick dancing. Dharmapuri, Tamilnadu, 1998

items.title: Possessed woman at goddess festival
items.caption: Udukkai and tappatai players drum and sing invocations to the goddess. Sikkamman temple festival, Mullukorai, Ootacamund, Tamilnadu 8/91
